Intenta.note: Do not translate. Product name. Never translate or inflect.

Google.note: Do not translate. As in 'Continue with Google'.

Katageno Limited.note: Do not translate. Company name in footer. Keep full address in English.

Amazon Pay.note: Do not translate. Payment method name.

Zoom.note: Do not translate. Third-party product name.

Meet.note: Do not translate. Third-party product name (Google Meet).

Teams.note: Do not translate. Third-party product name (Microsoft Teams).

ATS.note: Keep acronym. Add a gloss on first mention: ES 'sistemas ATS (de selección de candidatos)', PT-BR 'sistemas ATS (de recrutamento)'. In Spain ATS can also be read as the old term for nurse, so the gloss matters more in ES.

GDPR.note: Check and use local equivalent if there is one

256-bit AES and 256-bit SSL/TLS encrypti.t: Criptografia AES de 256 bits e SSL/TLS de 256 bits
256-bit AES and 256-bit SSL/TLS encrypti.note: 'Cifrado' is the standard ES term; keep it everywhere.

Join 1,000+ of professionals who use Int.t: Junte-se a +1.000 profissionais que usam o Intenta
Join 1,000+ of professionals who use Int.note: Numbers: ES has no thousands separator in 4-digit numbers (1000); PT-BR uses a dot (1.000).

Download.note: In sentences: ES 'Descarga la app' / PT-BR 'Baixe o app'.

Continue with Email.note: ES is long for a button; 'Continuar con email' if space is tight.

Remove AI.note: Button label. Must match the quoted button name in the 'By pressing "Remove AI"…' disclaimer.

Digite ou cole o texto aqui...
Click to upload or drag and drop: Clique para enviar ou arraste e solte

Try again.note: ES: never 'Intenta de nuevo' – it reads as the brand name.

subscription.note: Core term – pick one equivalent and never vary.

% off.note: ES: space before % (50 %). PT-BR: no space (50%).

Powered by.note: Payment-provider line. If it sits next to the provider logo and space is tight, 'Powered by' can stay in English.

auto-renews.note: Full pattern – ES: '{price} ahora; después se renueva automáticamente a {price} cada 4 semanas'. PT-BR: '{price} agora; depois renova automaticamente por {price} a cada 4 semanas'. Keep price placeholders movable.

Cancel anytime. Money-back guarantee upo: Cancele a qualquer momento. Garantia de reembolso mediante solicitação.

intro offer.note: Alternative if it must differ: 'oferta inicial' (ES/PT-BR).

Limited Time Offer For New users Only.t: Oferta por tempo limitado só para novos usuários

Money-Back Guarantee.note: Also 'money-back guarantee' in body text – same term.

You just saved {amount} ({pct}% off).t: Você acabou de economizar {amount} ({pct}% de desconto)

By continuing you indicate that you've a: Ao continuar, você concorda com nossos Termos e Condições

By pressing \"Remove AI\" you agree to o.t: Ao clicar em "Humanizar texto", você concorda com nossos Termos e Condições, Política de Privacidade e Política de Cookies. O resultado completo é desbloqueado com uma assinatura do Intenta. Cancele a qualquer momento nos ajustes do seu perfil. Termos de Assinatura.
By pressing \"Remove AI\" you agree to o.note: Fixed disclaimer under the 'Remove AI' button – always translate it exactly like this. The quoted button name must match the button label. ES uses «» quotes.

Terms and Conditions.note: Use the same title as the localized legal page. ES: sentence case (RAE standard).

AI Slop.note: As in 'We fight AI Slop.' Slangy term.

We fight AI slop. Here's how.t: Chega de enrolação de IA. Veja como.
We fight AI slop. Here's how.note: Hero headline – always translate as one string.

Voice options.note: Humanizer menu title. 'Voice' here means writing tone, not audio – don't use 'voz' / 'voz', which suggests audio in ES and PT-BR.

PRESETS.note: Humanizer voice menu label. Keep uppercase as in source.

The No-Nonsense Editor.note: Humanizer voice preset (dry, direct, no frills). Don't use 'editor': in Spanish it suggests a book publisher. Translate the four presets as a set: El Profesor / El Casual / El Amigo Ingenioso / El Directo.

The Witty Friend.note: Humanizer voice preset. 'Witty' = quick, sharp humor, so 'ingenioso' / 'espirituoso' rather than 'gracioso' / 'engraçado'. If menu space is tight: 'El Ingenioso' / 'O Espirituoso'.

AI score.note: Shown as a percentage on the AI gauge ('0% AI'). E.g. 'Paste text to get AI score' → ES 'Pega tu texto para ver el porcentaje de IA' / PT-BR 'Cole seu texto para ver a porcentagem de IA'. Gauge label: ES '0 % IA' / PT-BR '0% IA'.

AI text detection score.note: Always appears as the full term 'AI text detection score' – never translate 'detection score' on its own. Shows how much of a text is AI-generated. ES follows the same pattern as 'índice de fiabilidad'. Example: 'AI text detection score' → 'Índice de detección de IA'; 'See exactly how AI-generated a piece of text is — and the giveaway AI GPT detection patterns that ratted it out' → ES 'Descubre exactamente cuánto de IA tiene un texto y los patrones que lo delatan' / PT-BR 'Veja exatamente quanto de um texto foi gerado por IA e os padrões que o entregaram'.

remove AI.note: Literal 'quitar la IA' / 'remover IA' sounds unnatural.

trust score.note: Measures how reliable the text's claims and facts are (fact-check), not user trust. ES: e.g. 'Trust score with facts break-down' → 'Índice de fiabilidad con análisis de cada dato'; 'get a trust score in seconds' → 'obtén tu índice de fiabilidad en segundos'. PT-BR: 'Nota de confiabilidade com análise de cada fato'.

prompt.note: Usually kept in English in both markets.
